scenario.label_zh: 排查电脑程序的打印问题
scenario.goal_zh: 用简单对照测试区分程序问题和打印机问题

context_zh: 用户联系技术支持，说明一个程序打印时会关闭。
author: author-phase02-b

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: This program closes whenever I try to print the document.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Does it run normally when you just open and edit the file?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Yes. The trouble only starts when I select Print.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Let us try a quick test. Can you print a small text file from another application?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: That works. The page has come out.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Then the printer is responding. Save your work, and we can check the settings in the first application.
